newsitem.title: ITALY: United States, Romania to conduct joint exercises.
newsitem.headline: United States, Romania to conduct joint exercises.

text.p: U.S. and Romanian naval forces began a one-week sea and land training exercise in the Black Sea on Thursday, the U.S. Sixth Fleet said in a statement.
It said 1,300 U.S. personnel, a guided missile cruiser, a coastal patrol vessel and a transport ship were involved in the operation, codenamed Rescue Eagle 1997.
The joint exercises were designed to enhance cooperation between the two navies during humanitarian relief operations, the statement from the Naples-based fleet said.
